## Description

```
As the year comes to a close, Best of 2025 offers a moment to pause, reflect, and cherish the memories that made it meaningful. This thoughtfully curated collection brings together 59 tracks from 83 artists worldwide, offering almost two and a half hours of music on a special vinyl release. Explore a variety of styles including lofi study, jazz lofi, Asian lofi, medieval lofi, and soothing sleep tracks, highlighting the expanding diversity of the genre. This unique set of music captures the warmth, comfort, and creativity of a year in sound, accompanying you as you revisit memories, celebrate your journey, and embrace the possibilities of the year ahead!
```
